features.representation: 12-bin STFT chroma plus normalized onset strength

search.failureMode: fail closed when either frame or cell bound is exceeded

map.representation: monotonic adaptive piecewise-linear score-native-seconds to audio-seconds
map.anchorPolicy: deterministic largest raw-path deviation split; the bound is a target and the anchor limit is a safety ceiling

revealedDiagnosis.rawPathVsCompactMap: raw frame-path errors remain large on the two difficult revealed fixtures; 32-anchor compression adds only a small error increment, so map serialization is not the primary defect
revealedDiagnosis.ablationOne: feature ablation: removing onset evidence materially worsens every fixture; chroma-only is mixed and does not remove held-out regional errors
revealedDiagnosis.ablationTwo: multiscale downsampling alone does not remove the held-out regional errors; coarse paths remain ambiguous
revealedDiagnosis.referenceAttribution: SyncToolbox's remaining headroom is consistent with richer CENS/DLNCO/MrMsDTW-style feature and search mechanisms, but its scipy>=1.15 dependency conflicts with the existing worker scipy<1.13 runtime
revealedDiagnosis.decisionBeforeFresh: Use one bounded Strategy-A candidate; do not add SyncToolbox or tune against fresh outcomes

freshValidation.selection: pending candidate freeze; deterministic ASAP metadata/hash ordering, four composers, no prior three fixtures
